title: The shoulder
subtitle: How the shoulder works, how to load it, and when to refer
description: Eight lessons for working personal trainers: shoulder anatomy, scapulohumeral rhythm, common restrictions, screens and red flags, correctives, loading, throwing and rotation, and when to refer out. Science passages are bound to reviewed claims, and coaching practice is labelled as practice.
outcomes: Name the bones, joints and rotator cuff muscles of the shoulder.
Explain how the shoulder blade and the arm share elevation.
Choose and progress shoulder loading for healthy clients.
Recognise red flags and refer within your scope.

parts.title: The shoulder
parts.summary: From anatomy to loading and referral.
